title: Gate OAuth first-admin bootstrap
description:
P0: `GitHubOAuthCallbackHandler.cs:132` grants Admin to whoever completes GitHub OAuth first (`var isFirstAdmin = !await db.Users.HasAnyAdminAsync(ct)`) with no allowlist, bootstrap token, or loopback check. The fix pattern already exists in `SecurityServices.CreateFirstAdminAsync` (loopback + bootstrap token + `FixedTimeEquals`) but was never applied to the OAuth path.

Scope:
- Extract bootstrap-gating check out of `SecurityServices.CreateFirstAdminAsync` into a shared gate
- Call from both `CreateFirstAdminAsync` and `GitHubOAuthCallbackHandler.OnCreatingTicketAsync`
- Add test: first OAuth login from non-loopback with no token → `AuthenticatedDefaultRole`, not Admin

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-20260702.md §1.2, MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-3-20260702.md §3/§4, memorysmith-deep-audit-20260703.md §1

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 6-seat council audit synthesis. The fix pattern already exists in SecurityServices — this is a completeness gap, not a knowledge gap.
